$Comment: What every Focus row shares, in no set of its own (so no generator walks it): the three kind rows
(Mmo_Focus_Base_Weapon, _Element, _Defense) name it as their Parent and every Focus row names one of them, so a
value written here is every Focus's default, merged per name, and a kind row or a Focus row writes only what is
Vow, PathLine, PathGuard, HonedOne and HonedTwo are each step's amount on its line (a weapon's or an element's
damage, the Bulwark's Health); PathGuard is the Path's guard face, on Guard (and GuardTwo for a weapon). The
Signature adds no number: its worth is its proc or ability mod. NameKey, SignatureName and SignatureDesc name a
Focus's lang lines from its Key (its id lower-cased): mastery.focus.<key>.name, .signature and
.signature.desc in the pack's mmoskilltree.lang. Holder is the skill whose weapon a weapon Focus's line counts
with (MmoWeaponSkill), its home skill unless a row writes another.
Retune one Focus's amounts on the Mastery Focuses screen (/zigadmin) or in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/generator-rows.json under that Focus's row id (Mmo_Focus_Swords); the steps are written
again from the rows as soon as they move.
